query:
SELECT
           (floor(extract(epoch from captured_at) / $4::bigint) * $4::bigint)::bigint AS t,
           count(*) AS c
         FROM screen_frames
         WHERE agent_id = $1 AND captured_at >= $2 AND captured_at <= $3
           AND ($5::int IS NULL OR monitor = $5::int)
         GROUP BY t
         ORDER BY t
